description: PRO-LO Coherence Gate: multi-path consensus for one ticker across PRO-LO's independent real directional signals (trade-engine composite, daily SMA20/50 trend, SqueezeOS graded picks, SML Triple-Trigger). Returns each path with direction (long/short/flat) and confidence, the coherence score, and pass/block gate. Same formula as the SML mcp-x402 Coherent Gate. Jev (TypeSafe) review is not run over MCP.
name: coherence_gate_review
returns: JSON with paths[], path_sources[], coherence {coherence, consensus, gate, threshold}, and the documented direction mapping for every source.
